authorization.scope: Previously user-authorized performance program; root freezes this exact native paired schedule

binary.flags: opt-level=3, fat LTO, codegen-units=1, debug=1, incremental=0; RUSTFLAGS and CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS unset

claim_scope: Paired native phase latency for the explicit finite cold-session route only; whole-process RSS/resources include setup and oracles. No absolute comparison with0950, allocation, phase CPU-counter, OS-thread-count or production-adoption claim.

execution.schedule_note: six blocks per case/comparison, alternating ABBA and BAAB; each block has two adjacent A/B pairs

host.affinity_policy: preexec sched_setaffinity; live time-process leader mask witness; inherited by workload, no per-thread mask sampling

purpose: Fresh-process native managed-worker width comparison with strict v3 custody; no adoption or allocation claim.

report_contract.performance_claim: none; raw phase timings describe this explicit in-memory harness and do not claim OS thread counts, speedup, allocation behavior, or physical I/O
report_contract.phase_scope: ingress_ns is the direct SourceBackedEditor constructor; edit_commit_ns is selector staging, cell sets, and MultiCommit::commit; publication_ns is publish_multi_commit_to_stream plus returned MultiSnapshot drop; commit_drop_ns is MultiCommit drop; total_ns starts at the constructor and ends after commit teardown
report_contract.setup_scope: deterministic corpus and expected output construction, frozen source/output/semantic oracles, SourceCacheLimits and output ceiling, one untimed admission preflight, inverse patch, fresh OwnedSource clone, finite managed context, and sink capacity reservation are outside measured phases
report_contract.timing_scope: with fresh finite managed context prepared outside the clock, the timer begins at SourceBackedEditor construction and covers edit/commit, source-backed publication, returned snapshot drop, and commit/package worker-pool teardown; precomputed source/cache/context setup and bounded sink allocation are outside
report_contract.verification_scope: exact output bytes, immutable fixture source hash, output/semantic hashes, workbook verification, sink bounds, CpuTasks/OutputBytes counters, and post-drop Memory/Workers/IoConcurrency/Objects checks run outside timers; the untimed admission preflight verifies an actual managed-commit inverse (preflight_actual_commit_inverse_verified=true), while each timed sample applies the precomputed inverse patch only as a fixture to its published bytes (fixture_inverse_restored_exact_source)

source.source_cache_state: fresh process and in-memory OwnedSource; no cold filesystem claim

v3_custody.command_binding: argv,cwd,environment,deadline,requested mask,output/report paths are derived from plan and checked by reducer
v3_custody.outer_binding: capture-start and capture-terminal bind plan, runner, reducer, controls, and source manifest descriptors
v3_custody.row_binding: each child start/terminal row and index must equal deterministic schedule row
v3_custody.terminal_artifacts: post-terminal-artifacts.json binds stdout/stderr/time/report descriptors; validation binds terminal and report descriptors
